description: This file contains styles for the Tic Tac Toe game's frontend, utilizing Tailwind CSS for design and layout.

classes.name: game-cell
classes.description: Styles for each game cell in the Tic Tac Toe board, defining size, border, alignment, and hover effects.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Styles for the grid layout of the Tic Tac Toe board.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: Base styles for buttons used in the game with padding and transition effects.

classes.name: btn-primary
classes.description: Styles for the primary button in the game, including background color and hover effects.

classes.name: btn-accent
classes.description: Styles for the accent button in the game, including background color and hover effects.
